builds.name: Gladiator Nightmare DPS
builds.desc: The guide's main build in three stages. Fresh 45: Legend set at +10, first two Daevanion boards, actives at 10. iLv 3,000: Ebony Dragon Lord t3 at +15 and all four class boards. Endgame: t4 Splendent Ebony set with Ludra's Blade at +20, skill levels matching top Nightmare players (Overhead Slam 20 for its no-cooldown spec, Attack Preparation and Experienced Counterstrike 29). Specs follow Chef_Zhab's PvE video guide: Keen Strike MP regen, Leaping Slam Ankle Slice proc and reset on kill, Ruinous Blow range. Stigma order: Lunge Stance to 20 first, because its 1s cooldown cut on crits pairs with Overhead Slam's guaranteed crit; then Focused Block and Zikel's Blessing, with Rage Burst last. Play it from a priority macro: Leaping Slam in, Ruinous Blow, Focused Block on a parryable (yellow) boss attack, Rage Burst, then Overhead Slam every time it comes back.

builds.name: Gladiator AoE farming
builds.desc: Pack-clearing setup for dungeon trash and open-world farming at around iLv 3,000. Leaping Slam (AoE + pull) and Crushing Wave (pull) group mobs, Wrath Wave knocks them down, Lifestealing Blade keeps you topped up. Pull 4 mobs: every cleave caps at 4 targets.

builds.name: Gladiator Abyss PvP
builds.desc: Abyss and Arena diver. Same t4 gear as the PvE build but with PvP Damage Boost manastones, Tenaciousness and Blade Toss on the stigma bar, PvP specs (Ruinous Blow +12.5m range, Ankle Slice and Mocking Blade ignore Block) and the Azphel board filled for PvP stats. Open on healers with Blade Toss, Leaping Slam in, Mocking Blade into Overhead Slam and Aerial Snare, then Rage Burst and Ruinous Blow.

builds.name: Gladiator Transcendence
builds.desc: Long single-target boss fights. Sword Aura Rampage takes a bar slot for Stagger windows (its level-16 spec cuts every cooldown by 1s per hit), Zikel's Blessing takes the +50% Stagger spec, and bracelets lean on Illusion for shorter cooldowns.

builds.name: Assassin PvE progression (guide)
builds.desc: Starter path from the Assassin guide. Same three tiers as the Gladiator path with daggers: Fallen Ancient God at +10, Ebony Dragon Lord t3 at +15, then Ludra's Claw and Splendent Ebony Dragon Lord at +20. Bracelets lean on Death [Triniel] for crit, and armor manastones include Back Attack Damage Boost, as top-ranked Assassins run. Pair with the Illusive Clone opener in the guide.
